open.speaker: nii
open.text: {name}! You look like you didn't sleep. Was it the mosquitoes?

choices.text: The buzzing under the floor again. I need something to lift that tile.
Can I borrow a flat screwdriver? Don't ask.

tool.speaker: nii
tool.text: Ei. So I wasn't dreaming. Take this one — the flat one. If there's a snake under there, it's your snake.

noask.speaker: nii
noask.text: "Don't ask" is how every good story starts. Here. Bring it back with all its bits.
